Summary: Server SHALL support search parameter 'address' on Location resource
Context: The Plan-Net server must support searching for Location resources using the 'address' search parameter of type string. This parameter searches on Location.address and supports multipleAnd (parameter may repeat to specify multiple values that must all be true) and multipleOr (parameter may have multiple values separated by comma where at least one must be true). Allowed modifiers are 'exact' and 'contains'.
Section: 11.20.1 SearchParameter: Plannet_sp_location_address

Summary: Server SHALL support search by address-city parameter on Location resource
Context: The Implementation Guide defines a search parameter Plannet_sp_location_address_city that enables searching Location resources by the city component of their address. The parameter supports multipleAnd (parameter may repeat to specify multiple values that must all be true) and multipleOr (parameter may have multiple values separated by comma where at least one must be true). The allowed modifiers are 'exact' and 'contains'.
Section: 11.21.1 SearchParameter: Plannet_sp_location_address_city

Summary: Server SHALL support search by endpoint parameter on Location resource
Context: The Implementation Guide defines a search parameter Plannet_sp_location_endpoint that enables searching Location resources by their associated endpoint. The parameter is of type reference targeting Endpoint resources and uses the expression Location.endpoint. The parameter supports multipleAnd (parameter may repeat to specify multiple values that must all be true) and multipleOr (parameter may have multiple values separated by comma where at least one must be true). The allowed chain is 'organization'.
Section: 11.24.1 SearchParameter: Plannet_sp_location_endpoint

Summary: Server SHALL support searching Location by address state
Requirement: "Select Locations with the specified address.state [using search parameter `address-state` of type `string` with Expression `Location.address.state`]"
Context: The implementation guide defines a search parameter for finding Location resources based on the address.state element. This search parameter supports multipleAnd (parameter may repeat to specify multiple values that must all be true) and multipleOr (parameter may have multiple comma-separated values where at least one must be true). The 'exact' and 'contains' modifiers are allowed.
Section: 11.23.1 SearchParameter: Plannet_sp_location_address_state

Summary: Server SHALL support searching Location by partOf reference
Requirement: "Select Locations that are part of the specified location [using search parameter `partof` of type `reference` with Expression `Location.partOf` targeting Location resources]"
Context: The implementation guide defines a search parameter for finding Location resources based on the partOf reference element. This search parameter targets Location resources. MultipleOr is supported (parameter may have multiple comma-separated values where at least one must be true), while multipleAnd support is at the server's discretion. The allowed chains are: type, address, organization.
Section: 11.26.1 SearchParameter: Plannet_sp_location_partof

Summary: Support search by address-postalcode parameter on Location resource
Context: The Plannet_sp_location_address_postalcode search parameter allows searching for Location resources by postal code from the address. The parameter supports multipleAnd (parameter may repeat to specify multiple values that must all be true) and multipleOr (parameter may have multiple comma-separated values where at least one must be true). Allowed modifiers are exact and contains.
Section: 11.22.1 SearchParameter: Plannet_sp_location_address_postalcode

Summary: Server SHALL support organization search parameter on Location resource
Requirement: "Server SHALL support Parameter `organization`:`reference` [to] Select Locations managed by the specified organization [using Expression] `Location.managingOrganization` [with Target Resources] Organization [and] multipleAnd: The parameter may repeat in order to specify multiple values that must all be true [and] multipleOr: The parameter may have multiple values (separated by comma) where at least one must be true [and] Chains Allowed: name, address, partof, type"
Context: This requirement defines a reference-based search parameter for Location resources that allows filtering by managing organization. The search supports chaining to Organization resource attributes (name, address, partof, type) and allows multiple AND/OR combinations.
Section: 11.25.1 SearchParameter: Plannet_sp_location_organization

Summary: Accessibility Extension Value Binding Conformance
Requirement: "To be conformant, the concept in this element SHALL be from the specified value set if any of the codes within the value set can apply to the concept being communicated. If the value set does not cover the concept (based on human review), alternate codings (or, data type allowing, text) may be included instead."
Context: The Accessibility extension is used on Location resources to describe accessibility options offered by a practitioner or at a location. The value[x] element of this extension has an extensible binding to the AccessibilityVS value set. This requirement defines the conformance criteria for using codes from the bound value set.
Conditionality Details: The requirement applies when any of the codes within the AccessibilityVS value set can apply to the concept being communicated. If the value set does not cover the concept, alternate codings or text may be used instead.
Section: 11.66.1.1.1 Terminology Bindings

Summary: LocationReference Extension URL Fixed Value
Requirement: "The definition SHALL be a URI for the Structure Definition defining the extension."
Context: This requirement specifies that the Extension.url element must contain a URI that points to the Structure Definition for the location-reference extension. The fixed value for this extension is 'http://hl7.org/fhir/us/davinci-pdex-plan-net/StructureDefinition/location-reference'.
Section: 11.71.1 Extension: LocationReference - Detailed Descriptions

Summary: LocationReference Extension Value Must Support
Context: The value element of the location-reference extension, which contains a Reference to a Plan-Net Location resource, must be supported by implementations. This means that systems must be capable of populating and processing this element.
Section: 11.71.1 Extension: LocationReference - Detailed Descriptions

Summary: LocationReference Extension Cardinality
Context: The location-reference extension must have exactly one value element present. The cardinality of 1..1 indicates that the value is required and must appear exactly once when the extension is used.
Section: 11.71.1 Extension: LocationReference - Detailed Descriptions

Summary: Server SHALL support search-type and read interactions on Location resource
Requirement: "A Server SHALL support search-type, read [on Location resource]."
Context: This requirement mandates support for search-type and read operations on the Location resource.
Section: 11.1.1.2.4 Location

Summary: Server SHOULD support vread interaction on Location resource
Requirement: "A Server SHOULD support vread [on Location resource]."
Context: This requirement recommends support for version-specific read operations on the Location resource.
Section: 11.1.1.2.4 Location

Summary: Server SHALL support returning Location resource by id
Requirement: "A Server SHALL be capable of returning a Location resource using: GET [base]/Location/[id]"
Context: This requirement mandates the ability to retrieve a specific Location resource by its logical id.
Section: 11.1.1.2.4 Location

Summary: Server SHOULD support returning Location resource by version id
Requirement: "A Server SHOULD be capable of returning a Location resource using: GET [base]/Location/[id]/_history/vid"
Context: This requirement recommends the ability to retrieve a specific version of a Location resource.
Section: 11.1.1.2.4 Location

Summary: Server SHALL support _include for Location resources
Requirement: "A Server SHALL be capable of supporting the following _includes: Location:endpoint, Location:organization, Location:partof"
Context: This requirement mandates support for including referenced Endpoint, Organization, and parent Location resources when searching for Location resources.
Section: 11.1.1.2.4 Location

Summary: Server SHALL support _revinclude for Location resources
Requirement: "A Server SHALL be capable of supporting the following _revincludes: HealthcareService:location, InsurancePlan:coverage-area, OrganizationAffiliation:location, PractitionerRole:location"
Context: This requirement mandates support for reverse includes to retrieve HealthcareService, InsurancePlan, OrganizationAffiliation, and PractitionerRole resources that reference a Location.
Section: 11.1.1.2.4 Location

Summary: Server SHALL support search parameters on Location resource
Requirement: "A Server SHALL support the following search parameters on Location: partof, organization, endpoint, address-city, address-state, address-postalcode, address, type, _id, _lastUpdated"
Context: This requirement mandates support for searching Location resources by parent location, organization, endpoint, address components, location type, id, and last updated timestamp.
Section: 11.1.1.2.4 Location

Summary: Location resource SHALL have status fixed to 'active'
Context: The Plan-Net Location profile constrains the status element to always be 'active', indicating the location is currently in use. This is a mandatory constraint on all Location resources conforming to this profile.
Section: 11.60.1 Resource Profile: PlannetLocation - Detailed Descriptions - Location.status

Summary: Location resource SHALL have a name
Context: The name element is required and must be present with exactly one value. This represents the human-readable name by which the location is known.
Section: 11.60.1 Resource Profile: PlannetLocation - Detailed Descriptions - Location.name

Summary: Location resource SHALL support the identifier element
Context: Implementations must be capable of processing and storing business identifiers for locations. This allows locations to be uniquely identified within registries and systems.
Section: 11.60.1 Resource Profile: PlannetLocation - Detailed Descriptions - Location.identifier

Summary: Location resource SHALL support identifier.type element
Context: Implementations must be capable of processing the coded type for location identifiers to determine which identifier to use for specific purposes.
Section: 11.60.1 Resource Profile: PlannetLocation - Detailed Descriptions - Location.identifier.type

Summary: Location resource SHALL support identifier.value element
Context: Implementations must be capable of processing the actual identifier value that uniquely identifies the location within the context of its system.
Section: 11.60.1 Resource Profile: PlannetLocation - Detailed Descriptions - Location.identifier.value

Summary: Location resource SHALL support alias element
Context: Implementations must be capable of processing alternate names that the location is known as or was known as in the past, to support searches using historical names.
Section: 11.60.1 Resource Profile: PlannetLocation - Detailed Descriptions - Location.alias

Summary: Location resource SHALL support description element
Context: Implementations must be capable of processing the description of the location, which provides additional details to help identify the location beyond its name.
Section: 11.60.1 Resource Profile: PlannetLocation - Detailed Descriptions - Location.description

Summary: Location resource SHALL support type element
Context: Implementations must be capable of processing the category of service or resource available at the location, indicating the type of function performed at the location.
Section: 11.60.1 Resource Profile: PlannetLocation - Detailed Descriptions - Location.type

Summary: Location resource SHALL support telecom element
Context: Implementations must be capable of processing contact details of communication devices available at the location, including phone numbers, fax numbers, mobile numbers, email addresses and web sites.
Section: 11.60.1 Resource Profile: PlannetLocation - Detailed Descriptions - Location.telecom

Summary: Location resource SHALL support telecom.extension:contactpoint-availabletime
Context: Implementations must be capable of processing the days and times that contact points are available for the location.
Section: 11.60.1 Resource Profile: PlannetLocation - Detailed Descriptions - Location.telecom.extension:contactpoint-availabletime

Summary: Location resource SHALL support telecom.extension:via-intermediary
Context: Implementations must be capable of processing references to alternative points of contact for the location, which may be PractitionerRole, Organization, OrganizationAffiliation, or Location resources.
Section: 11.60.1 Resource Profile: PlannetLocation - Detailed Descriptions - Location.telecom.extension:via-intermediary

Summary: Location resource SHALL support telecom.system element
Context: Implementations must be capable of processing the telecommunications form for contact points (phone, fax, email, pager, url, sms, other).
Section: 11.60.1 Resource Profile: PlannetLocation - Detailed Descriptions - Location.telecom.system

Summary: Location resource SHALL support telecom.value element
Context: Implementations must be capable of processing the actual contact point details in a form meaningful to the designated communication system.
Section: 11.60.1 Resource Profile: PlannetLocation - Detailed Descriptions - Location.telecom.value

Summary: Location resource SHALL support address element
Context: Implementations must be capable of processing the physical location address where the location can be visited.
Section: 11.60.1 Resource Profile: PlannetLocation - Detailed Descriptions - Location.address

Summary: Location resource SHALL support address.line element
Context: Implementations must be capable of processing the street address components including house number, apartment number, street name, street direction, P.O. Box number, and delivery hints.
Section: 11.60.1 Resource Profile: PlannetLocation - Detailed Descriptions - Location.address.line

Summary: Location resource SHALL support address.city element
Context: Implementations must be capable of processing the name of the city, town, suburb, village or other community or delivery center.
Section: 11.60.1 Resource Profile: PlannetLocation - Detailed Descriptions - Location.address.city

Summary: Location resource SHALL support address.state element
Context: Implementations must be capable of processing the sub-unit of a country with limited sovereignty in a federally organized country, using codes such as US 2-letter state codes.
Section: 11.60.1 Resource Profile: PlannetLocation - Detailed Descriptions - Location.address.state

Summary: Location resource SHALL support address.postalCode element
Context: Implementations must be capable of processing postal codes (zip codes) designating a region defined by the postal service.
Section: 11.60.1 Resource Profile: PlannetLocation - Detailed Descriptions - Location.address.postalCode

Summary: Location resource SHALL support position element
Context: Implementations must be capable of processing the absolute geographic location of the location expressed using the WGS84 datum, required for mobile applications and automated route-finding.
Section: 11.60.1 Resource Profile: PlannetLocation - Detailed Descriptions - Location.position

Summary: Location resource SHALL support managingOrganization element
Context: Implementations must be capable of processing references to the organization responsible for the provisioning and upkeep of the location, constrained to Plan-Net Organization resources.
Section: 11.60.1 Resource Profile: PlannetLocation - Detailed Descriptions - Location.managingOrganization

Summary: Location resource SHALL support partOf element
Context: Implementations must be capable of processing references to another Location of which this Location is physically a part, constrained to Plan-Net Location resources.
Section: 11.60.1 Resource Profile: PlannetLocation - Detailed Descriptions - Location.partOf

Summary: Location resource SHALL support hoursOfOperation element
Context: Implementations must be capable of processing the days and times during a week that the location is usually open.
Section: 11.60.1 Resource Profile: PlannetLocation - Detailed Descriptions - Location.hoursOfOperation

Summary: Location resource SHALL support hoursOfOperation.daysOfWeek element
Context: Implementations must be capable of processing which days of the week are available between the start and end times.
Section: 11.60.1 Resource Profile: PlannetLocation - Detailed Descriptions - Location.hoursOfOperation.daysOfWeek

Summary: Location resource SHALL support hoursOfOperation.allDay element
Context: Implementations must be capable of processing the indicator of whether the location is open all day.
Section: 11.60.1 Resource Profile: PlannetLocation - Detailed Descriptions - Location.hoursOfOperation.allDay

Summary: Location resource SHALL support hoursOfOperation.openingTime element
Context: Implementations must be capable of processing the time that the location opens.
Section: 11.60.1 Resource Profile: PlannetLocation - Detailed Descriptions - Location.hoursOfOperation.openingTime

Summary: Location resource SHALL support hoursOfOperation.closingTime element
Context: Implementations must be capable of processing the time that the location closes.
Section: 11.60.1 Resource Profile: PlannetLocation - Detailed Descriptions - Location.hoursOfOperation.closingTime

Summary: Location resource SHALL support availabilityExceptions element
Context: Implementations must be capable of processing descriptions of when the location's opening hours are different to normal, such as public holiday availability.
Section: 11.60.1 Resource Profile: PlannetLocation - Detailed Descriptions - Location.availabilityExceptions

Summary: Location resource SHALL support endpoint element
Context: Implementations must be capable of processing references to technical endpoints providing access to services operated for the location, constrained to Plan-Net Endpoint resources.
Section: 11.60.1 Resource Profile: PlannetLocation - Detailed Descriptions - Location.endpoint

Summary: Location resource SHALL support extension:newpatients
Context: Implementations must be capable of processing the New Patients extension indicating whether new patients are being accepted in general or from a specific network. This provides flexibility for specifying whether a provider accepts new patients by location and network.
Section: 11.60.1 Resource Profile: PlannetLocation - Detailed Descriptions - Location.extension:newpatients

Summary: Location resource SHALL support extension:accessibility
Context: Implementations must be capable of processing the Accessibility extension describing accessibility options offered at a location.
Section: 11.60.1 Resource Profile: PlannetLocation - Detailed Descriptions - Location.extension:accessibility

Summary: Location resource SHALL support extension:region
Context: Implementations must be capable of processing the Location Boundary (GeoJSON) extension representing a boundary shape that represents the outside edge of the location in GeoJSON format. The format is GeoJSON in both JSON and XML formats with mimetype 'application/geo+json'.
Section: 11.60.1 Resource Profile: PlannetLocation - Detailed Descriptions - Location.extension:region

Summary: Location resource SHALL have status fixed to 'active'
Requirement: "The status property covers the general availability of the resource, not the current value which may be covered by the operationStatus, or by a schedule/slots if they are configured for the location. [The] status [element has a] Fixed Value: active"
Context: The Plan-Net Location profile constrains the status element to always have the value 'active', indicating that locations in this implementation guide must be currently available resources.
Section: 11.60.1 Resource Profile - Plan-Net Location

Summary: Location resource SHALL have a name element
Requirement: "Name of the location as used by humans. Does not need to be unique. [Cardinality] 1..1"
Context: The Plan-Net Location profile requires that every location have a human-readable name to identify the facility or location.
Section: 11.60.1 Resource Profile - Plan-Net Location

Summary: Location position element SHALL include longitude
Requirement: "Longitude. The value domain and the interpretation are the same as for the text of the longitude element in KML (see notes below). [Cardinality] 1..1"
Context: When the absolute geographic location of a Location is provided using the position element, the longitude must be specified as a required component with WGS84 datum.
Conditionality Details: This requirement applies when the Location.position element is present.
Section: 11.60.1 Resource Profile - Plan-Net Location

Summary: Location position element SHALL include latitude
Requirement: "Latitude. The value domain and the interpretation are the same as for the text of the latitude element in KML (see notes below). [Cardinality] 1..1"
Context: When the absolute geographic location of a Location is provided using the position element, the latitude must be specified as a required component with WGS84 datum.
Conditionality Details: This requirement applies when the Location.position element is present.
Section: 11.60.1 Resource Profile - Plan-Net Location

Summary: Location SHALL conform to accessibility extension binding
Requirement: "Accessibility [extension with] Binding: [Accessibility VS] (extensible): To be conformant, the concept in this element SHALL be from the specified value set if any of the codes within the value set can apply to the concept being communicated."
Context: The Location profile includes an accessibility extension that describes accessibility features of the location. When codes from the specified Accessibility VS value set can apply, they SHALL be used.
Conditionality Details: This requirement applies when providing accessibility information and a code from the Accessibility VS value set can apply to the concept being communicated.
Section: 11.60.1 Resource Profile - Plan-Net Location

Summary: Location address state SHALL use USPS codes when applicable
Requirement: "Sub-unit of country (abbreviations ok) Binding: [USPS Two Letter Alphabetic Codes] (extensible): To be conformant, the concept in this element SHALL be from the specified value set if any of the codes within the value set can apply to the concept being communicated."
Context: When specifying a US state in a Location address, the two-letter USPS alphabetic codes SHALL be used when applicable.
Conditionality Details: This requirement applies when providing a US state value and a code from the USPS Two Letter Alphabetic Codes value set can apply to the concept being communicated.
Section: 11.60.1 Resource Profile - Plan-Net Location
